capabilities: Generate and review a preview of planned file moves before applying them
Move notes, images, videos, audio, attachments, templates, canvases, and bases files into configurable folders
Resolve filename conflicts and retry failed renames with fallback methods
Remove empty folders after moves, ignoring hidden dotfiles
Name generic images and convert handwritten-note images to Markdown using OpenAI vision
extras: The README warns users to back up or sync the vault before running a bulk move, and the marketplace description notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Vaults that have grown into hundreds of folders are hard to reorganize by hand, and Obsidian has no bulk preview-and-apply tool for restructuring files.

relations.evidence: Can use OpenAI vision to preview subject-based filenames for generic image names such as IMG_1234.jpg

summary: Bulk vault reorganization tool that previews and applies file-moving plans to flatten large vaults into a simpler folder structure.
